L0H0_ATTN.hypothesis: Attention spreads across multiple positions (BOS ~60%, second-half positions ~6-8% each, first-half ~1-2% each on uniform input); ablating it changes L0_MLP writes uniformly across all positions (max|diff| 1.5-2.1 at every position), not concentrated at specific routing targets.

L0_MLP.hypothesis: Fuses own-position embedding with the L0H0_ATTN aggregate write; ablating L0_MLP (r6) makes all first-half positions output the halved value instead of the full value, showing it combines positional and token information from two distinct sources.

L1_MLP.hypothesis: Fuses own-position embedding with upstream contributions from L0H0_ATTN and L0_MLP; ablating L1_MLP (r8) causes the BOS position prediction to change from 4.5 to 0.5, showing it combines multiple upstream sources.

L2_MLP.hypothesis: Fuses own-position embedding with contributions from L0H0_ATTN, L0_MLP, and L1_MLP; ablating L2_MLP (r10) causes prediction errors at multiple positions, confirming it combines multiple upstream sources.

L3_MLP.hypothesis: Fuses own-position embedding with contributions from all upstream listed components; ablating L3_MLP (r16) causes prediction errors at multiple positions (e.g., input 1 pos5-9 becomes 5,4,3,5,1 instead of 2.5,2,1.5,1,0.5), confirming it combines multiple upstream sources.
